groundOriginMethod: Midpoint of opaque contacting boot spans in final4/5 sole rows, both feet when both contact; no sword-tip anchors. Falling/lying frames use lower-quarter landing contact span, not the death image height or sword tips; parent must verify corpse placement.
alphaPolicy: Original built-in extraction output bytes. Alpha>=16 geometry; native unlit low-alpha test remains parent-owned. Failed recolor-alpha candidates preserved as siblings.
